chapter: Freelance and studio work in New York
title: Tommy Dorsey and Artie Shaw start their own bands
summary: Dorsey and Shaw formed bands and Challis stayed contentedly in the studios, not seeking work with them.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: out. Tommy's got his band out first, you know, and he comes in occasionally with Eli Oversinger was down at Victor and he comes in with, he told me, "The way I do it, I come back in with about 30 arrangements and make them in maybe one or two settings."
: Because the band has already been playing them.

The band has already been playing them out on the road. And I knew a lot of the guys in the band. But I knew Tommy better, you know. I didn't do any work for him, which was all right with me, I didn't look for any work. I was busy in the studios. I was content.
